name: La Fille aux Pommes
source:
A little girl and her big sister live in a house surrounded by a huge farm. The big sister likes to grow potatoes. However, the little girl prefers to collect apples. Her dream is to be able to make dishes shared with the general public from her apples... when they will in her apple tree, of course!

When her big sister has to go away for a while, the little girl is left to her own. To not get bored, she wants to try to imitate her big sister by growing the same potatoes and taking them to the villagers.
